name: Blue-Ringed Octopus

items.name: Blue-Ringed Octopus Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 17 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d4 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 3 1d6 poison damage and Paralyzed (1 round)

items.name: Camouflage
items.text: The blue-ringed octopus can change the color of its skin to hide even if it doesn't have cover.

items.name: Jet
items.text: The blue-ringed octopus moves up to 60 feet in a straight line through the water without triggering reactions.

items.name: Toxic Bite
items.text:
Requirements The blue-ringed octopus has a creature Grabbed

---

Effect The blue-ringed octopus makes a beak Strike against the grabbed creature. If it hits, it injects additional poison, causing its venom to gain the virulent trait.

text: While relatively small, the blue-ringed octopus is particularly venomous for its size.
